solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Intelligent tramp has to get a move on

parts.note: a quick mind is an intelligent one
to tramp is to walk heavily, to march

explanation.surface: A clever vagrant is being told to hurry along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick march!' is the drill-sergeant's order to set off briskly, so it stands for the instruction itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The military command tells soldiers to start marching at normal pace, i.e. to hurry up and go.

clue.text: County must run health centres, which is not normal

indicators.note: the centres of each of the four words County, must, run and health are taken in turn

explanation.surface: A council insists that clinics be run abnormally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centres' takes the middle letters of County, must, run and health: UN, US, U, AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unusual departs from the ordinary, the standard or expected state of affairs.

clue.text: Used to focus on Harris, cos something started to change

indicators.note: the letters are made to change places, so the words before are rearranged
the start of the word something gives its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone sets their sights on a person called Harris because something has begun shifting.
explanation.walkthrough: HARRISCOS plus S (the start of 'something') is rearranged by 'to change'.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosshairs are the fine lines in a gunsight or telescope used for aiming at a target.

clue.text: Girl in focus going up for laxative

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step
in a down clue going up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to focus on is to aim at
Agnes is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl in the spotlight rising up, then a purgative.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'going up' reads the word for focus from the bottom, giving MIA, with the girl tucked inside; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Milk of magnesia is a long-established remedy for constipation.

clue.text: In order to call, do reconnect; this way there aren't any leads

definitions.text: do reconnect; this way there aren't any leads

parts.note: to radio someone is to call them up
things in order are under control, controlled

explanation.surface: Instructions to redial and reconnect a device, noting it has no cables.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue lists 'In order' first, but the answer puts the radio part first.
explanation.definitionFit: A device operated by radio signals needs no wires or cables to its controller.

clue.text: Repair man gets new lead and may appear on Strictly Come Dancing

definitions.text: may appear on Strictly Come Dancing

indicators.note: the first letter of the tradesman is swapped for a different one

parts.note: a roofer is a man who repairs roofs

explanation.surface: A builder with a new start appears on a TV dance show.
explanation.walkthrough: The R at the front of ROOFER becomes H. Strictly Come Dancing is a popular BBC ballroom dance contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoofer is slang for a professional dancer, the sort who competes on a dance show.

clue.text: Material reworked? Search me!

indicators.note: something reworked has been redone, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asked about altered fabric, someone shrugs: no idea!
explanation.walkthrough: 'reworked' rearranges the letters of SEARCH ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is fine wool from Kashmir goats, woven into a fabric.

clue.text: Satisfied when revealed deception has seen off Edward

parts.note: a con is a deception or swindle

indicators.note: to see off is to get rid of, so a letter is removed

parts.note: to evince is to reveal or show
E taken as a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A trickster is pleased their fraud got rid of a man called Edward.
explanation.walkthrough: CON plus EVINCED with its first E removed by 'has seen off'; E for Edward is a loose abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To be convinced is to be persuaded, i.e. satisfied that something is true.

clue.text: Directions Jane followed to African republic

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: S, E, N and E are four compass directions: south, east, north, east
jane is slang for a woman, a gal

explanation.surface: A woman named Jane follows directions to an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: Senegal is a republic on the west coast of Africa, capital Dakar.

clue.text: Player going first in Manchester United shoot-out

indicators.note: the leading letters of the words that follow are taken

explanation.surface: A footballer takes the first kick in a penalty shoot-out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going first in' takes M, U, and S and O from shoot-out.
explanation.definitionFit: A muso is a musician, someone who plays an instrument.

clue.text: Indoor gang refurbished decorative edging

indicators.note: something refurbished is redone, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A team working inside renovates ornamental trim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refurbished' rearranges INDOOR GANG.
explanation.definitionFit: Gadrooning is ornamental moulding of convex curves, used on silver, furniture and architecture.

clue.text: Scrap awful results right away

indicators.note: awful results are a mess, so the letters are jumbled
right goes away, removed from the word

explanation.surface: Throw out the dreadful figures straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' takes R from RESULTS, and 'awful' rearranges ESULTS.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap is a fight or scuffle, which a tussle also is.

clue.text: Windows of opportunity provide means of access

explanation.surface: Chances also give a way in.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening is both an opportunity and a physical gap you can pass through.

clue.text: The Godfather who sank all but the last three pina coladas

indicators.note: drinks sank are downed and churned up, so the letters are mixed
the final three letters of the cocktail name are dropped

explanation.surface: A mafia boss downs a lot of cocktails.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the last three letters leaves PINACOLA, which 'sank' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Al Pacino starred as Michael Corleone, who became the Godfather of the film trilogy.

clue.text: Persuadable, and when daughter's included, can be adjusted

indicators.note: the letter is put inside the other word

parts.note: amenable means open to persuasion
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: Someone is flexible, and with a daughter added the plans can change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included' puts D inside AMENABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something amendable can be altered or revised, as a law or text can.

clue.text: Company's large failure led to breakdown

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
a lapse is a failure or slip

explanation.surface: A firm's big failure triggered its collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: A collapse is a sudden failure or falling apart, as a breakdown is.

clue.text: Castle workshop turned over, honest

indicators.note: the word is turned, so its letters run backwards

parts.note: a lab is a workshop for experiments
moral means upright, honest

explanation.surface: A castle's workroom was turned upside down by a decent person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' makes LAB into BAL. Balmoral is the royal family's castle in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Balmoral Castle in Aberdeenshire is a Scottish residence of the British monarch.

clue.text: See 15
Official will drum up content of exercise in school

indicators.note: the reversed drum forms the contents held inside the other piece

parts.note: PE is physical education, exercise at school

indicators.note: in a down clue up means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a tabor is a small drum

explanation.surface: A school official will drum up something about the PE lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: A tabor is a small old drum; 'up' reads it bottom to top as ROBAT, and 'content of' makes that the filling of the school-sport abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Probate is the legal process proving a will, and also the officially certified copy of it.

clue.text: Spooner's animals slipped in salt- water channel

indicators.note: Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the first sounds change places

parts.note: deer are animals
tucked means slipped in

explanation.surface: Creatures fell into a salty waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the starts of DEER TUCKED gives 'tear ducked', which is said much like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tear ducts carry tears, salty water, from the eye to the nose.

clue.text: Spoke of ball player and period of game play

indicators.note: spoken, so it is the sound of the word that counts

parts.note: a chucker is one who chucks or throws a ball

explanation.surface: Someone talks about a footballer and a phase of play.
explanation.definitionFit: A chukker is one of the periods of play in a polo match.

clue.text: Teases Sam, rejected by playful film stars

indicators.note: Sam is turned away by the stars, so those letters are removed
the remaining letters play about, signalling rearrangement

explanation.surface: Mischievous actors spurn a man named Sam.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing S, A, M from FILM STARS leaves FILTRS, which 'playful' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To flirt is to toy playfully with someone's affections, which is a way of teasing them.

clue.text: Weary, having no energy, but inwardly mellow in disorderly house

indicators.note: the word is left without the letter, so it is removed

parts.note: weary of something means bored
E is the abbreviation for energy in physics

indicators.note: only the inside letters of mellow are taken

explanation.surface: Someone tired and drained, yet calm inside, ends up in a seedy place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having no' drops E from BORED; 'inwardly' takes ELLO from mellow. A disorderly house is a legal term for a brothel.
explanation.definitionFit: A bordello is a brothel, which old law called a disorderly house.

clue.text: Mother's call missed second beastly driver

parts.note: ma is a word for mother

indicators.note: the letter is missed out, removed

parts.note: to shout is to call out

explanation.surface: Mum didn't hear a second shout from a nasty motorist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missed' takes S out of SHOUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A mahout drives and tends an elephant, so his driving is done on a beast.

clue.text: See 3
Siberian intruder?

parts.note: a Siberian is a breed of cat, so a Siberian intruder is a cat that breaks in

explanation.surface: A trespasser from Siberia.
explanation.walkthrough: Siberian looks like a nationality, but it is a breed of cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat burglar is a thief who climbs nimbly into buildings, and here also literally a feline.

clue.text: Gervais loses his head, and that's unpleasant

indicators.note: the first letter of the name is cut off

parts.note: Ricky Gervais is a British comedian

explanation.surface: A comedian is beheaded, which is nasty.
explanation.walkthrough: Ricky Gervais is the British comedian behind The Office.
explanation.definitionFit: Icky is informal for distasteful or sickly, i.e. unpleasant.

clue.text: See 7 across
Consequence for jockey who's been up for too long

definitions.text: Consequence for jockey who's been up for too long

parts.words: Consequence for jockey who's been up for too long
parts.note: being up means riding in the saddle, and too long there leaves a rider sore

explanation.surface: A jockey who stayed up too late pays the price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'been up' suggests staying awake late, but for a jockey it means mounted on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Riders get chafed and aching from long hours on horseback in the saddle.
